title: Look up a named value
summary: PHP: Look up a named value. Read the pages key instead.
introduction: An array can use text keys. A key is a label used to find a value.
learningObjectives: Look up a named value with PHP

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
The title key points to Moon Trip. Reading it does not return the whole array.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use => between a key and its value.
